summary: The 'profilePopup' function manages the display of profile icons and opens new windows based on profile status.
purpose: To display profile icons according to their existence status and open a new window with a specified URL.

workflows.name: profilePopup Function Execution
steps: Check if an icon for the previous profile exists.
Determine the existence status of the previous profile and update the icon accordingly.
Check if an icon for the current profile exists.
Determine the existence status of the current profile and update the icon accordingly.
Open a new window with the provided URL.

system_behavior: Updates profile icon to indicate existence status.
Opens a new window with the specified URL.
